title: Checks for equal operands to comparison, logical and bitwise, difference and division binary operators (==, >, etc., &&, ||, &, |, ^, - and /).
summary: This is usually just a typo or a copy and paste error. Clippy puts this lint in the correctness group, at the level deny.

title: Checks for pattern matchings that can be expressed using equality.
summary: Clippy puts this lint in the nursery group, at the level allow.
